title: LA Colossal – Cloisonné 04 (Seated)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Chinese woman in her early 20s, long straight black hair with a jade clip, natural face with a sweet smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the stool, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body cloisonné enamel body painting in jingtailan style, from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, no collar band. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no qipao, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. Glossy turquoise enamel base with raised gold wire cells filled with lotus, goldfish, and water ripples. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated upright on a carved stone garden stool, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch turquoise enamel platform Mary Jane stilettos with gold wire buckles.
Nails: Extra long oval nails, turquoise with coral dots.

Background & Lighting: Classical Suzhou garden with a lotus pond and moon gate, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft daylight with warm raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
